card.name: Small words after a dose, before the patient group
card.fires_on: Short linking words like "in" or "for" right after a dose amount or a condition in dosing text. The next words name the patient group (adults, pediatric patients) or the indication.

modes.label: "in" before a population
modes.description: The word "in" follows a dose or duration and comes just before adults or pediatric patients.
modes.example: The maximum recommended daily dose of metformin hydrochloride tablets is 2550 mg<< in>> adults and 2000 mg

modes.label: "For" or "for" before an indication
modes.description: A linking word opens a dosing statement or follows a drug name or duration, before a condition or patient group.
modes.example: 2.2 Osteoarthritis<< For>> OA, the dosage is 2

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated words from other languages.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that links a dose to who it is for, such as "in adults" or "for pediatric patients".
